items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: items a-f each have a red-first test in test_promise_hash_hardening.py; the weak promise tests (AC04, AC10, AC11, AC13, AC12 exact map) are strengthened or narrowed with an honest note; no SKILL.md or product script change

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: a rebound test name and a missing or malformed covers id raise ValueError; lock_problems reports them as problem strings; lock_key refuses absolute paths

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: test support only; no network, no secrets; the hash closes bypasses (alias, rebinding, autouse, hooks, covers-with-code, binding-free statements)

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: every new rule has a swap that would have hidden it; oracle functions mutated by hand and red; the golden promise tests stay green against the unchanged skill

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: closure walk is linear in the reached bindings; golden promise tests about 100 s on Windows

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: promise_hash.py 277 lines, promise_lock.py split off to stay under 300, ruff clean, new files in REQUIRED

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: promise_list.json is read back by the meta test (check id renamed for AC10); the fingerprint is computed from source text only and the pinned digest is equal on 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13; no CRLF in hashed content
